newsitem.title: UK: Tradepoint raises 775,000 stg via placing.
newsitem.headline: Tradepoint raises 775,000 stg via placing.

text.p: Tradepoint Investment Exchange, the main rival to the London Stock Exchange, said on Wednesday it has raised 775,000 stg through a placing of 1.6 million new shares at 50p per share.
It said that the money will be used as working capital ahead of the outcome of long term financing talks.

The company, which is traded on the Alternative Investment Market in London and the Vancouver Stock Exchange, has already entered into an interim financing arrangement through its broker Williams de Broe.

As part of the placing arrangements, Tradepoint has agreed that the maximum number of ordinary shares available for release to holders of ordinary shares held in escrow will be cut to 1.02 million from 5.70 million.
Tradepoint, which offers investors a facility to buy and sell shares electronically in more than 900 British companies, said it plans to make an announcment on long term financing by the end of July.
